meta.title: ARU STAY — A calm base in Seoul
meta.description: A warm, thoughtful stay near Wangsimni. Long stays welcome.

hero.title: A cozy base for your days in Seoul.
hero.subtitle: Soft, warm, and thoughtfully cared for. Stay a night, or stay a while.

about.title: Run by travelers, for travelers.
about.body: ARU STAY is a small, internationally friendly stay in the heart of Seoul. We keep things simple and kind — clean rooms, quiet mornings, and an easy, self-guided rhythm. We truly enjoy what we do, and we care deeply about every guest who walks through our doors. More than anything, we hope ARU STAY feels like a place you can feel at ease, just like home.

points.title: A stay made with care
points.body: We pay attention to the little things that make your stay comfortable.

points.title: Thoughtfully made, simply run
points.body: We all love traveling, and we understand the joy it brings. We try to share that same feeling with every guest who stays with us.

points.title: A place to feel at ease
points.body: We hope you feel relaxed, comfortable, and truly welcomed here.

rooms.title: Not too much, not too little.
rooms.subtitle: Our rooms are compact, but thoughtfully arranged with the essentials for a comfortable stay. We keep things simple, practical, and reasonably priced, so you can enjoy Seoul without paying for more than you need.

location.title: Near Wangsimni — a quiet hub, close to everywhere.
location.body: ARU STAY sits a short walk from Wangsimni Station, a major transit point connecting you across Seoul in minutes.
location.nearby: Around the stay you'll find convenience stores, Olive Young, Daiso, and local supermarkets — everything for daily life.

items.q: Can I check in late at night?
items.a: Yes, you can. From 9:00 PM, when the front desk closes, until 3:00 AM the next day, check-in is available through our contactless check-in support system. No worries — we'll make sure you can check in smoothly.

items.q: Do you offer discounts for long stays?
items.a: We welcome stays of 10 nights or more. Please send a direct inquiry through our Long Stay form and we'll reply with a personalized rate.

items.q: Where exactly is ARU STAY located?
items.a: We're a few minutes on foot from Wangsimni Station in Seongdong-gu, Seoul — a major transit hub connecting most of the city in 15 minutes.

items.q: How does payment work for direct inquiries?
items.a: After we confirm availability, we send a personal payment link by email. You only pay once we've confirmed your dates.
English, Japanese, Chinese and Korean. Please feel free to message us in any of these languages.

items.q: When is free luggage storage available?
items.a:
We offer free luggage storage both before check-in and after check-out.

Before check-in: You may leave your luggage at the front desk, and once your room is ready after cleaning, we will place it in your room for you.

After check-out: Luggage storage is available until 1 hour before the front desk closes.
Monday to Saturday: until 8:00 PM
Sunday: until 6:00 PM
